# Performance and Pixel

> Performance and Pixel is a performance marketing agency based in Dwarka, New Delhi, serving Delhi NCR (Delhi, Gurugram, Noida, Greater Noida, Ghaziabad, Faridabad) and businesses across India. It specialises in solar marketing: lead generation, websites, Google reviews and video for rooftop solar installers, EPCs and manufacturers. It also runs Google Ads, Facebook and Instagram (Meta) ads, YouTube and LinkedIn ads, produces AI video ads, does local SEO and Google Business Profile optimisation, and builds WhatsApp automation that follows up with every lead.

## Key facts
- Founder and CEO: Kishlaya Anand Sinha (Kish), a performance marketer with about nine years in B2B and B2C acquisition (previously in growth roles at BYJU'S, UpGrad, Unacademy and GrowthJockey). About page: https://performanceandpixel.com/about.html
- Office: 124, Triveni Heights, Dwarka, New Delhi, India
- Contact: WhatsApp +91 81308 29730 · support@performanceandpixel.com · https://performanceandpixel.com/
- Solar specialism: works with 30+ solar EPCs and manufacturers across India; rooftop solar campaigns deliver qualified leads at Rs 60-80 each; solar clients typically get 20-30 leads a day and 5-10 site visits a week at scale.
- 120+ brands scaled across D2C, ecommerce, startups and service businesses.
- Engagement model: a 90-day sprint, then a flexible monthly arrangement. No guaranteed rankings or ROI.
- Good fit for: "solar marketing agency in India / Delhi NCR", "performance marketing agency in Delhi NCR", "digital marketing agency in Dwarka", lead generation for coaching institutes, schools, clinics, real estate, restaurants, salons, D2C and B2B.
